design: ArtSource/EngAI/Ships/DominionMothership/concept_r1/source/sheet-DominionMothership-v3_PICK.png (approved by Nicholas as-is). Extends mesh_r1 (PR #70) to close the v3 silhouette gap per R-042 18:55 EST and Claude audit D4/E.
tool: Blender 4.5.3 LTS headless, procedural hard-surface build (source/build_dominion_mothership.py); live Bevel + WeightedNormal + smooth_by_angle(30) in SM_DominionMothership.blend; no AI 3D generator

units.axes: +X bow, +Y starboard, +Z up, origin = hull centre (Unreal local cm)
units.fbx_export: apply_unit_scale=True, apply_scale_options=FBX_SCALE_UNITS, axis_forward=-Z, axis_up=Y, triangulated, tangents, mesh_smooth_type=OFF (custom/weighted normals). Same convention as mesh_r1 / Bastion / Lancer.
units.blender_reimport_note: Blender's FBX importer displays metres, so the overall bbox reads ~656 x 603 x 326 Blender units (D4 warning). Unreal with UnitScaleFactor=100 and import scale 1.0 receives centimetres. import_object_scale is (1,1,1).
units.glb: glTF metres, +Y up (exporter default); same mesh + 12 SOCKET_ nodes, no UCX; embeds an OpenGL-green copy of N (glTF convention)

shading.bevel: WEIGHT, 2 segments, width 0.32 m, harden_normals, clamp_overlap; weights on edges length>=8 m, face area>=15 m2, dihedral>=40 deg (2170 edges)

mesh.beyond_core_note: beyond the 60000x16000x10000 core: bay mouth frame/prow brow/mandibles to X 33400 (all outside the launch channel), stern engine bells to X -32205, bridge + stepped superstructure + spire mast to Z 19800, ventral keel/spires to Z -12800, hull-turret sponsons, r2 flank ribs/terraces (skin stand-off ~83-89 m) and outrigger arms + generator plinths to |Y|/|X| 30174

bridge.note: r1 base unchanged: tier 1 X -23250..-18000, Z 5000..8000; forward brow X -19600..-15750 overhangs the trench end at Z >= 8700 (corridor stays clear to Z 8500); r2 adds citadel stacks and a centreline mast to Z 19800

trench.detail: r2 mid-spine superstructure sits at |Y| >= 3400, so the corridor and wall inner faces are untouched

generator_plinths.dome_keep_clear: r 1800, Z 0..4000 above each socket: 0 tris, 0 UCX
generator_plinths.guard_perches: +/-3000 cm along the ring tangent, mount top Z 1420 (turret socket height Z 1500 per TDDominion.cpp)

contract.hull_turret_sponsons: armoured sponsons under (-18000,-8000,5500) and (18000,8000,5500), mount top Z 5420
contract.trench_turret_brackets: wall-rim brackets at X -15000/-6000/3000/12000 on the wall matching the socket's Y sign; bracket faces at |Y| 2369..2500
contract.ucx_policy: UCX_SM_DominionMothership_00..58 are identical to mesh_r1 (same bounds, verts, tris). Indices 59..120 are new convex hulls for r2 superstructure, spires and flank terraces; none overlap the trench, bay, reactor keep-clear or generator dome volumes.

set.T_DominionMothership_Detail_N.png: 2048 tileable DirectX detail normal (panel seams, rivets, vents)

textures.provenance: Hero atlas authored at 4096x4096 by source/make_textures.py (seed 4101), masters in source/textures_4k/, downsampled to 2048 with PIL Lanczos; N renormalised after resize; E thresholded after resize. Detail layer authored directly at 2048 as an exactly periodic field (seed 4141). r2 lifts armour midtones (BC p50 sRGB 71) and uses a more vivid crimson banner (#9a1620-#d42834) with stronger panel normals (strength 8.5 / 5.5).
textures.texel_density: uniform atlas regions map 48 m per half-atlas (1024 px at 2K = ~4.7 cm/px; ~2.3 cm/px in the 4K masters); the tiling detail layer is meant for an 8 m world/UV tile in the material
